lines.trans: Let us look for this form on his computer.
Wait, what is this?
It is an open draft email.
I made promises to Ulrika...
So that she signs the contract...
But I plan to discourage her gradually...
We can replace her later on...
Use the expense account...
For an animal foundation...
My God, this is total betrayal!
He lied to everyone.
Camille? Did you find that form?
Here are two glasses to celebrate this!
Yes, everything is fine, dad.

examples.text: Ça va? Oui, ça va bien.
examples.trans: How are you? Yes, I'm fine.

meanings.note: ça va? = how are you? / are you okay?

examples.text: Des animaux qui gambadent dans les bois?
Il y a un macaron sur la table.
examples.trans: There's a macaron on the table.

meanings.note: elle a quarante ans = she is forty

meanings.en: il y a = there is / there are

meanings.note: as a masculine noun: pour le bien de = for the good of
before a noun: ce film, cette tête, ces gens
as a pronoun in c'est, ce n'est pas; becomes c' before a vowel

examples.text: Des gens comptent sur ce film.
examples.trans: People are counting on this film.

meanings.en: compter sur = to count on, to rely on

examples.text: La plus grande imprésario de Paris.
Il ne faut pas se décourager.

meanings.en: to discourage; se décourager = to lose heart

examples.text: Elle est trop vieille pour le rôle.
examples.trans: She's too old for the part.

meanings.note: pour faire quoi? = to do what?
faire du vélo = to ride a bike, to cycle

examples.text: Elle donne de l'argent à une fondation.
examples.trans: She gives money to a foundation.

examples.text: On fête son anniversaire ce soir.
examples.trans: We are celebrating her birthday tonight.

meanings.note: before the verb: vous la connaissez? les voilà

examples.text: Je veux, mais je ne peux pas.
examples.trans: I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Il a mis le dîner sur sa note de frais.
examples.trans: He put dinner on his expense account.

meanings.note: before the noun; nouvel before a vowel
everyday speech, with a he/she verb form

examples.text: Laisse ton ordinateur et tes dossiers.
examples.trans: Leave your computer and your files.

meanings.note: past participle of 'ouvrir' used as adjective
pronounced plys when it means 'more' at the end

examples.text: Je suis là pour voir Mathias.

examples.trans: I can't take it any more.

meanings.note: je peux t'appeler? = may I call you?
je n'en peux plus = I can't take any more
faire une promesse = to make a promise; tenir sa promesse = to keep one's promise

examples.text: Qu'est-ce que tu fais à Paris?
examples.trans: What are you doing in Paris?

meanings.note: starts a question: qu'est-ce que tu fais? = what are you doing?

examples.text: Dis-lui que je ne peux pas venir.

examples.trans: Are we going to replace Françoise?
I'll stand in for you tomorrow.

meanings.note: rien n'est signé = nothing is signed
agrees with the thing owned, not the owner

examples.text: Le livre est sur la table.
examples.trans: The book is on the table.

meanings.note: sur la table, sur la route

meanings.en: à plus tard = see you later

examples.text: Sans totale liberté, l'art est inutile.
examples.trans: Without total freedom, art is useless.

examples.text: Ça ne va pas du tout.

meanings.note: oui à tout = yes to everything
plural tous (pronounced 'tous' with s): merci à tous
before a noun: tout le monde = everyone
takes a singular verb: tout le monde est là

meanings.en: trouve quelque chose = think of something

meanings.note: singular and informal: friends, family, children, colleagues of the same age

examples.text: Un verre d'eau, s'il vous plaît.

meanings.note: prendre un verre: to have a drink
to present something or someone near you
place: à Paris, à mon cours

meanings.en: au = à + le, aux = à + les
